1. 先查同一天的去程和回程: 1. Plan both directions for the same day
输入实际起终点，选择准备通勤的日期；周末、节假日和晚归需要分别查询。: Enter your actual origin, destination and commute date. Check weekends, holidays and late returns separately.

2. 按你实际能到达的车站查: 2. Check the stations you can actually reach
查 BART 去程、回程与末班车: Check BART trips and last trains
BART 官方应用可按起终点规划含接驳的行程，查看实时发车、取消班次、服务和电梯: BART's official app plans trips with connections and shows live departures, cancellations, service and elevator alerts, and station last trains. Check both directions for your travel day. Record the time needed for connections at either end.
查 Caltrain 停站与首次乘车步骤: Check Caltrain stops and boarding steps
先选平日或周末时刻表，看清所选车次停不停你的起终点，再看实时提醒和站台方向。不同: Choose the weekday or weekend schedule and check that your train stops at both your stations, then look at live alerts and the platform direction. Stopping patterns differ, so not every train in your direction stops at your station. Have a valid ticket before boarding and tap off if using Clipper. Station pages show upcoming trains and facilities.
查 VTA 公交、轻轨和接驳: Check VTA buses, light rail and connections
VTA 的官方说明推荐用 Transit 输入目的地、选择路线并跟踪车辆。把公交: VTA's instructions recommend Transit for entering a destination, choosing a route and tracking vehicles. Check each bus or light rail connection from home to the station and from the station to work, including alerts. Live arrival estimates change with conditions.
3. 用完整往返成本比较开车和拼车: 3. Compare the full round-trip cost of driving and carpooling
公共交通记录当前路线票价、接驳和车站停车费；开车记录油电、桥费、目的地停车和实际: For transit, record current fares, connections and station parking. For driving, include fuel or charging, tolls, destination parking and actual traffic delays. Add constraints such as school pickup, carrying items or overtime. If office days vary, compare individual trips with longer-term passes using your own schedule.
拼车先写清接送点、往返时间、费用分摊、迟到等待和临时取消规则。: Before carpooling, agree on pickup points, both departure times, shared costs, how long to wait and cancellation arrangements.
司机或同伴临时去不了时，你自己也有办法回家。: Keep a way to get home on your own if the driver or another rider cancels.
比较相同日期、相同到达要求的方案；预计值和已经试跑的值分开填写。: Compare routes for the same date and arrival requirement. Record estimates separately from measured trial results.
